senses.gloss:
व्यृ व्य्-ऋ (वि-ऋ), cl. 5. 3. P. -ऋणोति or -ऋण्-
वति, -इयर्ति, &c. (see rt. 4. ऋ), Ved. to go apart or
asunder, open out, be divided; to open, throw open,
spread abroad, display.

व्यृछ् व्य्-ऋछ् (वि-ऋछ्), cl. 6. P. -ऋच्छति,
-अर्च्छितुम्, Ved. to go apart or asunder.

व्यृध् व्य्-ऋध् (वि-ऋध्), Pass. -ऋध्यते,
Ved. to be unfortunate or unsuccessful; to be ex-
cluded or deprived of (with inst.): Caus. -अर्ध-
यति, -यितुम्, to exclude from, deprive of (with
inst.): Pass. of Caus. -अर्ध्यते, to be excluded
from or deprived of: Desid. वीर्त्सति (Part. वीर्त्सत्),
to wish to nullify or render vain.

व्य्-ऋद्धि, इस्, f. (probably fr. वि privative + ऋद्-
धि), non-prosperity, absence or loss of prosperity,
misfortune, ill luck.

व्यृष् 1. व्य्-ऋष् (वि-ऋष्), cl. 1. P. -अर्षति,
-अर्षितुम्, Ved. to flow through.

व्यृष् 2. व्य्-ऋष् (वि-ऋष्), cl. 6. P. -ऋषति,
-अर्षितुम्, to pierce, penetrate.
